user_requirement: On the homepage, the Szolgáltatások top-level menu item must not appear active.
preserve: Főoldal remains the native current-menu-item on the homepage.
Szolgáltatások remains current on actual service subpages.
Hover, focus and open-dropdown feedback on Szolgáltatások remains source-like.
All menu destinations, labels and dropdown contents remain unchanged.

runtime_guard.homepage_test: Treat the WordPress root pathname '/' as homepage regardless of query string or hash.
runtime_guard.services_parent: On homepage only, remove/never add .is-current from the Services custom dropdown host.
runtime_guard.services_children: On homepage only, remove aria-current='page' from runtime Services panel anchors.
runtime_guard.native_wp_classes: Do not mutate WordPress current-menu-* classes; the paired CSS guard neutralizes any false parent highlight visually only on body.home/body.page-id-56.
runtime_guard.non_home: Outside the homepage, use the normal exact route-group matching from the authoritative header runtime package.

prewrite_guard: Read the live Code Snippets ID7 body and require the expected current hash before editing.
Capture the complete immediate prewrite body for rollback.
Apply only the homepage Services-current exception; do not touch other runtime behavior.
Read back active=true and code_error=null before browser verification.
browser_acceptance: At https://alakfamester-wp.clicknest.hu/ the Főoldal item is current and Szolgáltatások is visually neutral at rest.
Hover/focus/open on Szolgáltatások still shows normal interactive feedback.
On a service subpage such as /idos-fak-megmentese-szolgaltatas/ Szolgáltatások still shows the current-section state.
